name: Cherricia
source:
One day a mediocre college student Keiji picks up an abandoned kitten. However, at home kitten turns into a girl. The cohabitation with cat-girl becomes a mix of love and carnal desires.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一天，一名平庸的大学生庆二捡起了一只被遗弃的小猫。然而，在家里，小猫变成了女孩。与猫女的同居变成了爱情和肉欲的混合体。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
